## 答案：**26 位**不同的患者满足所有筛查条件

根据视频中配置的 **encounter-level 诊断追踪规则**（批次 #TRK-2024-07），筛查条件如下：

| 条件 | 配置内容 |
|---|---|
| **Dx1（前序诊断）** | 肺炎（所有类型，如 pneumonia, aspiration pneumonia 等） |
| **Dx2（后续诊断）** | 低镁血症（所有类型，如 hypomagnesemia, etiology unknown 等） |
| **时间顺序** | Dx1（肺炎）诊断时间 **早于** Dx2（低镁血症）诊断时间 |
| **就诊范围** | **同一住院就诊**（Same Hospital Encounter，即相同 patienthealthsystemstayid） |
| **日期过滤** | 已锁定（不额外限制） |
| **就诊范围锁定** | 已锁定（确认为同一住院口径） |

WITH pneumonia_dx AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.patientunitstayid, p.patienthealthsystemstayid, p.uniquepid, 
           d.diagnosisname, d.diagnosistime
    FROM diagnosis d
    JOIN patient p ON d.patientunitstayid = p.patientunitstayid
    WHERE LOWER(d.diagnosisname) LIKE '%pneumonia%'
),
hypomagnesemia_dx AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.patientunitstayid, p.patienthealthsystemstayid, p.uniquepid,
           d.diagnosisname, d.diagnosistime
    FROM diagnosis d
    JOIN patient p ON d.patientunitstayid = p.patientunitstayid
    WHERE LOWER(d.diagnosisname) LIKE '%hypomagnes%'
)
SELECT DISTINCT pn.uniquepid, pn.patienthealthsystemstayid,
       pn.diagnosistime AS pneumonia_time,
       hm.diagnosistime AS hypomagnesemia_time,
       pn.diagnosisname AS pneumonia_dx,
       hm.diagnosisname AS hypomagnesemia_dx
FROM pneumonia_dx pn
JOIN hypomagnesemia_dx hm ON pn.patienthealthsystemstayid = hm.patienthealthsystemstayid
WHERE pn.diagnosistime < hm.diagnosistime
ORDER BY pn.uniquepid, pn.diagnosistime;
